scope: Conditional DAV delivery between separate freightctl custody instances with revision-guarded private staging

original_failure.observation: Both Linux jobs stopped when the test tried to change staging permissions without the current directory revision.

local_replay.environment: Native macOS ARM, Go 1.27.4 race build, two separate scoped PostgreSQL databases and disk custody roots, loopback TLS and real DAV delivery. Inference disabled.
observations: The setup read the ordinary directory stat and pinned its revision for the owner-only mode change. The resulting directory retained the same entry ID and recorded exactly one revision increase.
The ordinary sender delivered through a private exclusive stage and a conditional MOVE. A separate inbox principal read the exact receiver bytes. The staging name disappeared after success.

An existing destination held different bytes. The MOVE preserved those bytes, kept the staging bytes private and returned an ambiguous outcome. Further send work refused. Read-only reconciliation retained the same attempt and fence.
The original Linux Actions test keeps its exact candidate and platform checks and runs the same custody journey as the local test.

remaining: Run the original two-custody journey on the exact native Linux candidate.
The independent stock receiver overwrote an existing exclusive stage in its distinct original test. Its contract, the remaining native DAV results and full qualification stay open.
